svg.aria-label: The refute skill: the first run and the run over a repair round. Boxes: Reviewer: the diff against the brief, the checks and the quoted commands rerun (agent); A model other than the configured one (stop); The report saved, its usage filled (a step of the session); Each finding closed or raised (a step of the session); Reviewer over a repair round: the delta (agent, only when needed).
